description: This PHP source file provides API functions for managing data model parameters related to the CCSP (Cloud Computing Service Platform) Data Model, including functions to get/set parameters, retrieve instance IDs, and manipulate object instances within the data model.

methods.name: DmGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values with a common root object, returning a status code and data array.

methods.name: DmSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter values under a common root object, returning a status code.

methods.name: DmGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs under a specified object table, returning a status code and instance list.

methods.name: DmAddObj
methods.description: Adds a new object instance under a specified object table, returning the new instance ID or error code.

methods.name: DmDelObj
methods.description: Removes an object instance specified by its name, returning a status code.
